race.description: Emirates Park Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: DR HOOK (7) resumes as the horse to beat after contesting stakes races last time in. Closed his last campaign with two seconds, including a placing here as the favorite, losing by a length and a half to Cormier after giving his weight. Trained locally and should be able to put these away. TENNESSEE RIVER (12) poses a clear threat after a determined first-up second here, where she jumped awkwardly, raced wide, yet was only a length and a half behind. Her fourth in the Listed Woodlands Stakes offers the best feature reference in the field. Maps well. GIDGEA TREE (2) is on debut for the Mack Griffith yard and draws well with Aaron Bullock aboard. Finished a close second in a Muswellbrook trial over 800m. Forward showing expected. TOKE (5) resumes after five months with some honest winter form, but his 900m record leaves him with work to do. Wider plays.
